description: Try a hosted model on a request context before (or after) promoting a version: the price it would give, and what the model said (a demand model's chance of a sale and elasticity, or a price model's output). Uses the active version unless version names another, and 409 when there is none. Nothing is metered or logged as a quote. Answers 404 not_released while hosted models (the hosted-pricing-models release) are not switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with function test scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

max_price.description: The price is at most this.

min_price.description: The price is at least this.

context.description: The request context to price, as compute_price takes it. current_price is required.

buyer_type.description: Optional: whether the buyer is an agent or a person.

currency.description: Optional ISO currency code, e.g. USD.

current_price.description: The current price; a ratio model and a demand model price from it.

metadata.description: Optional extra fields a model can read as metadata.<key>, such as unit_cost.

model_id.description: The hosted model's id: id on a list_hosted_models result.

version.description: The version to try. Defaults to the active one.

name: predict_with_hosted_model
